# Lumines Labs

> > Lumines Labs develops professional cinematography and rendering plugins for Unreal Engine and Unity, including Cinematographer and Vintage Film.

Lumines Labs, founded by Maximilian Grienig in Hamburg, Germany, specializes in photorealistic camera systems and film simulation tools for real-time engines. The flagship product Cinematographer provides physically accurate camera controls, while Vintage Film offers detailed celluloid emulation.

## Key Topics

- Cinematographer
- Vintage Film
- Unreal Engine
- Unity
- Physical Light
- Photorealistic rendering
- Camera system
- Lens simulation
- Film simulation
- High Definition Render Pipeline
- Illuminance and lux values
- Camera presets
- Lighting reference
- Cinematographer Lite

## Core Products

- [Cinematographer - A Photorealistic Camera System - Documentation](https://www.lumines-labs.com/Cinematographer-Documentation.html): Complete documentation for the Cinematographer plugin, covering photorealistic camera controls, lens simulation, and camera presets for Unreal Engine
- [Vintage Film - A Unreal Engine Plugin for Ultra Detailed Celluloid Film Simulation](https://www.lumines-labs.com/vintage/VintageFilm.html): Plugin for ultra-detailed celluloid film simulation in Unreal Engine, providing authentic analog film aesthetics

## Reference & Tools

- [Physical Light Cheat Sheet](https://www.lumines-labs.com/PhysicalLight_CheatSheet.html): Comprehensive reference guide for physically accurate lighting with lux values, illuminance measurements, and lighting scenarios
